analysis: Examined test-only changes. Gemma4TensorParallelTests.swift (added, head 444-609 visible) exercises tensor-parallel shard/oracle equivalence, a GEMMA_TP_DIAG env-gated diagnostic, vocabulary-split greedy/top-k selection and row gather on CPU with synthetic weights; it writes temp synthetic model directories and removes them via defer. No production code, secrets, network, or prompt data are involved. ResidentAdmissionGemma4Tests.swift head line 495 now expects the Gemma4 registered rows to advertise supportedGenerationModes [.pipeline, .tensorParallel], implying a production change in RegisteredResidentModels/Gemma4 capability metadata (not in this batch). That production change belongs to the cluster worker boundary (TB-011 Stage D default-off candidate); integration should verify that tensor-parallel mode keeps the same admission checks (identity/artifact/config hashes, arithmetic environment, JACCL rank, deadline bounds) as pipeline mode, that the vocabulary-split all-sum/gather between ranks does not cross an untrusted boundary or skip encryption, and that any prefix-cache use in TP mode retains cacheSalt scoping (T-041). No regression is observable from test code alone.
